name: gathercheats
title: GatherCheats
description: Quickly change Gather's game speed and save or teleport to frequently used locations.
author: charles_bushong

commands.name: gathercheats-4x-speed
commands.title: Set 4x Speed
commands.subtitle: Gather Desktop
commands.description: Opens Gather’s developer console, sets the game speed modifier to 4×, then closes the console. Reset the speed by getting on and off a go-kart.

commands.name: save-gather-spot
commands.title: Save Current Spot
commands.subtitle: Gather Desktop
commands.description: Save your current map and position in Gather as a named teleport destination.

commands.name: teleport-to-gather-spot
commands.title: Teleport to Saved Spot
commands.subtitle: Gather Desktop
commands.description: Search your saved Gather locations and teleport to one instantly.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
